title: Diagonal/DNC orientation of a trivial bundle equals inverse integration transpose
statement:
Fix the finite coefficient conventions [def-pur-conventions]: $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k)$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, $n\geq1$, and $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$. Let $Y$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. For $d\geq0$ put $X_d=\mathbf A^d_Y$ and $p_d:X_d\to Y$ [def-sbc-affine-space], with $X_0=Y$ and $p_0=1_Y$. Use the small pro-etale derived categories, derived pullback and tensor [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], the specified Tate twists [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], compact supports [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], and constructible exceptional inverse images [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Write $\otimes=\otimes_A^L$ and $\omega_f=Rf^!A_{\operatorname{target}(f)}$. The vector integration $t_f:Rf_!A_{\operatorname{source}(f)}(r)[2r]\to A_{\operatorname{target}(f)}$ for a rank-$r$ trivial bundle $f$ is [def-amb-vector-integration], realized on this site by [lem-pur-vector-integration-site-comparison]. Write $P_{f,H}:Lf^*H(r)[2r]\to Rf^!H$ for the exceptional transpose of $(1_H\otimes t_f)\Pi_{f;A(r)[2r],H}$, where $\Pi_{f;M,H}:Rf_!(Lf^*H\otimes M)\to H\otimes Rf_!M$ is the inverse of the canonical compactification projection [def-exchange-projection], with tensor symmetries inserted.

For $p=p_d$, put $X=X_d$, $W=X\times_YX$, let $p_1,p_2:W\to X$ be the first and second projections, and let $\Delta:X\to W$ be the diagonal. Let $C(g,s)=Ls^*\omega_g$ be the section invariant [def-pur-section-invariant], let $N=N_{\Delta/W}$ be the normal bundle [def-pur-normal-bundle], and let $\pi_N:N\to X$ and $0_N:X\to N$ be its projection and zero section. Use the ordered normal coordinates induced by $u_i=y_i-x_i$ on $W$; thus $N\cong\mathbf A^d_X$ with ordered coordinates $v_i$ corresponding to $u_i$, and the standard deformation has $u_i=t v_i$. Let $\alpha:C(p_1,\Delta)\xrightarrow{\sim}\omega_p$ be [lem-pur-diagonal-base-change], $\delta:C(p_1,\Delta)\xrightarrow{\sim}C(\pi_N,0_N)$ the normalized DNC comparison [thm-pur-dnc-invariance], and let $\beta:C(\pi_N,0_N)\xrightarrow{\sim}A_X(d)[2d]$ be $L0_N^*(P_{\pi_N,A_X}^{-1})$ followed by the canonical Tate restriction. Set $J=P_{p_1,A_X}$ and $P=P_{p,A_Y}$; these are integration-transposed isomorphisms [thm-amb-vector-bundle-purity]. Let $B:Lp_2^*\omega_p\to\omega_{p_1}$ be the counit-transposed dualizing base-change map of [def-pur-co-smoothness](3).

The specified maps satisfy, as equalities of derived morphisms,
$$J=B\circ Lp_2^*P,\qquad \alpha\circ L\Delta^*J=P,$$
$$\beta\circ\delta=(L\Delta^*J)^{-1},\qquad \beta\circ\delta\circ\alpha^{-1}=P^{-1}.$$
The Tate restrictions and pullback-composition identifications are understood. The translation $h:W\to\mathbf A^d_X$, $(x,y)\mapsto(x,y-x)$, identifies the integration and its transpose for $p_1$ with those of the trivial bundle on the right, with the stated ordered normal coordinates. All these equalities hold for every $n\geq1$, independently of an annihilating exponent $\ell^rA=0$. For $d=0$ they are identities, including over the empty base.

proof.text: The explicit constructions and already proved coordinate specifications are publicly reexported from [def-pur-affine-diagonal-integration-constructions], with identical names, types and non-theorem bodies.
Apply [lem-pur-affine-diagonal-trace-restriction] for each q,hq to obtain I,J,Q with the three prescribed hom maps, trace base change and T alpha = I.
Apply [lem-pur-affine-diagonal-dnc-normalization] to the same pinned J,Q to obtain delta beta = T inverse.

Rewrite alpha inverse followed by delta and beta as alpha inverse followed by T inverse. Invert the isomorphism equality T alpha = comparison(I), obtaining alpha inverse T inverse = comparison(I inverse). The private inverse_composite lemma proves this by Iso.ext and congrArg Iso.inv. The private orientation_composite helper carries the entire groupoid calculation; the final application supplies alpha, delta, beta and comparison.mapIso I explicitly from the goal.

For the exponent clause, apply the exponent comparison in [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback] on U. The root map satisfies the kernel-inclusion power equation, and its degree-one isomorphism satisfies the pure-generator formula. Apply [lem-pur-affine-diagonal-transpose-power] for the equality of the presented transposes. Unfold presented integration as the inverse exceptional Hom bijection and apply homEquiv_naturality_left_symm to obtain the lowerShriek integration equation. No statement or definition changes.

The separately stated translation and rank-zero clauses remain pending, with their original source proofs. Translation uses the actual trace and its exceptional mate; rank zero uses the identity tower and identity adjunction.
